conditions.objetP1: DropLink gives sellers a space in which to create, for each of their orders, a private page reachable through an unguessable link. That page gathers the photos and videos uploaded by the seller together with the parcel's shipping status.
conditions.objetP2: DropLink never takes part in the transaction between a seller and their customer: no payment is processed, collected or facilitated by the service.
conditions.compteP1: Creating orders requires an account. Viewing a page as the recipient of a link requires none: the recipient is neither registered, nor identified, nor solicited.
conditions.compteP2: An order's link is immutable. The seller may revoke it at any time, which makes it permanently inoperative and generates a new one.
conditions.contenusP1: The seller remains solely responsible for the content they upload and warrants holding the necessary rights. Infringing or unlawful content, and content harming third-party rights, are prohibited.
conditions.contenusP2: DropLink acts as a host: the service exercises no prior control over uploaded content, and does not select it.
conditions.retraitP1: Anyone may report content they consider unlawful. Every report is reviewed, and the account concerned may be suspended as a precaution — its pages then immediately stop being served.
conditions.retraitP2: Suspension is reversible: reactivation restores the pages on the same links.
conditions.disponibiliteP1: The service is provided as is, during its validation phase, free of charge and without any availability commitment. Tracking information comes from carriers: we guarantee neither its accuracy nor its freshness.
conditions.disponibiliteLacune: LIABILITY LIMITATION CLAUSES TO BE DRAFTED
conditions.donneesP1: Data processing is described in the privacy policy. The recipient's name is free text entered by the seller; it constitutes neither an account nor an identifier.
conditions.resiliationP1: The seller may stop using the service at any time.
conditions.resiliationLacune: DATA DELETION TERMS AND RETENTION PERIOD TO BE SET
conditions.droitLacune: GOVERNING LAW AND COMPETENT JURISDICTION TO BE SET WITH THE LAWYER
conditions.retraitFormulaire: Reports are made using the form provided for that purpose.

confidentialite.collecteP1: For a seller: their email address, the name and settings of their shop, and the content they upload. For a recipient: nothing that identifies them. Viewing a page records a salted fingerprint of the IP address and browser, never the values themselves.
confidentialite.pasDeCompteP1: Viewing a page creates no account, asks for no address and installs no advertising tracker. The name shown on the page is free text entered by the seller: it designates no user of our service.
confidentialite.indexationP1: Order pages carry a no-index directive, appear in no gallery and are reachable through no internal search. No rich preview is produced for messaging apps: a preview would show the content to people who never open the link.
confidentialite.conservationP1: An order's content is kept for as long as the seller keeps it. Raw carrier responses are purged ninety days after the parcel's last movement. Administration records are retained and survive the deletion of the account concerned.
confidentialite.conservationLacune: RETENTION PERIOD AFTER ACCOUNT CLOSURE TO BE SET
confidentialite.droitsP1: Access, rectification, erasure, objection. Write to us at the contact address shown on the reporting page.
confidentialite.droitsLacune: DATA CONTROLLER AND CONTACT DETAILS TO BE SET

docs.resume: DropLink turns an order into a tracking link you send to your customer. You add your photos and the tracking number; DropLink queries the carrier and updates the status on its own. This guide covers every screen, from creating your account to reading your <analyses>analytics</analyses>.
docs.presentationTexte: DropLink solves a single problem: customers asking ten times where their parcel is. The principle fits on one line.
docs.fait1: Create an order from the customer name, your photos and a tracking number.
docs.fait2: Generate a unique tracking page, in your colours, that the customer opens without an account.
docs.fait3: Pull carrier information and move the status forward automatically.
docs.fait4: Give you an overview: shipments in progress, parcels with no movement, links opened.
docs.faitPasTexte: DropLink is not a marketplace and does not manage your catalogue. You will find no products, quantities, prices, cart or revenue: that data belongs to your shop, not to your tracking.
docs.etape1Texte: With an email address and a password, from the sign-up page. No bank card is required.
docs.etape2Texte: The name and logo appear at the top of every customer page.
docs.etape3Texte: You get a link to share straight away.
docs.combienTexte: An account takes under a minute, and the first tracking link goes out in the same session. There is no carrier integration to configure beforehand.
docs.marqueTexte: The My brand screen is an editor for your customer page, not a plain form: every change shows immediately in the preview.
docs.regLogoE: Shown in the header, next to the shop name.
docs.regNomE: Identify your shop to the customer.
docs.regCouleurE: Applied to the page accents. Default: #5B4BF5. Contrast is adjusted automatically so the text stays readable.
docs.regSociauxE: Instagram, TikTok, WhatsApp and website, shown when filled in.
docs.regFiligraneE: Stamps your name on the photos you upload.
docs.commandeTexte: The Create an order button sits on the orders list. The form fits in three blocks, with the customer page preview alongside.
docs.blocClientTexte: The customer's name or handle, and an optional email. The email is only used to send the link; it creates no account.
docs.blocMediasTexte: Drop your files: the order, the packing, the sealed parcel.
docs.blocSuiviTexte: Paste the tracking number. DropLink recognises the carrier and starts querying it.
docs.sauvegardeTexte: The order saves itself as you fill it in. Adding a tracking number later is enough to start tracking.
docs.mediasTexte: Media are the heart of DropLink: they replace the back-and-forth messages. Add them by drag and drop or by picking files, and reorder them with the mouse or the keyboard.
docs.media1: Photos and videos are accepted. The first image is used as the cover.
docs.media2: Twenty media per order, including three videos.
docs.media3: The customer opens each photo full screen, and plays videos without leaving the page.
docs.suiviTexte: You have no status to enter. Paste the tracking number: DropLink queries the carrier and updates the page.
docs.suiviAlerteTitre: A freshly pasted number has not been scanned yet
docs.suiviAlerteTexte: It is not an error: the carrier simply has not published anything. The page says so, and never « number not found ».
docs.statutsTexte: The tracker has four steps, and it never goes backwards. Finer detail lives in the tracking history, not in the tracker.
docs.stPreparationE: The number is saved, the carrier has published nothing yet.
docs.stExpedieE: The carrier has picked up the parcel.
docs.stTransitE: The parcel is moving; every movement shows on the customer page.
docs.stLivreE: The carrier has confirmed the parcel was handed over.
docs.silenceTitre: Silence is named after ten days
docs.silenceTexte: A parcel with no movement for more than ten days is flagged, on the Shipments screen and on the customer page. Named silence is information; unexplained silence reads as a failure.
docs.lienTexte: Every order has its own link. Your customer opens it without an account, on mobile or desktop, and finds your photos, the parcel status, the movement history and your contact details if you filled them in.
docs.lienAlerteTitre: The link never changes on its own
docs.lienAlerteTexte: You can edit an order you already sent: the customer sees the update on the same link. Only « revoke and regenerate » creates a new address, and it cuts off the old one for good.
docs.envoisTexte: The Shipments screen groups all your parcels, regardless of orders. It is the view to open when you look for what has stopped moving: the default sort brings immobile parcels to the top.
docs.analysesTexte: Analytics measure your use of DropLink and the effectiveness of your tracking. No revenue data appears: DropLink does not know your prices.
docs.notificationsTexte: When you fill in your customer's email, they get a message when the parcel is delivered. You stay in control: the email is optional, and it never creates an account.
docs.plansTexte: DropLink is free during the validation phase. The Pro plan is shown here so you know where the product is heading; no payment is asked today, and no limit is enforced.
docs.plPageP: Branded, link under your own name
docs.faqQ1: Does my customer need an account?
docs.faqR1: No. They open the link and see their order immediately, with no signup and nothing to install.
docs.faqQ2: Do I have to update the status myself?
docs.faqR2: No. The tracking number is enough: DropLink queries the carrier and moves the status on its own.
docs.faqQ3: Can I create an order without a tracking number?
docs.faqR3: Yes. Create it, share the link, and add the number once the parcel ships: the customer sees the update on the same link.
docs.faqR4: No. DropLink handles no catalogue, no payment and no prices: only tracking and customer communication.
docs.faqQ5: How long does my link stay active?
docs.faqR5: As long as you want. A link does not expire on its own: only « revoke and regenerate » replaces it.
docs.faqQ6: What does my customer see if I revoked the link?
docs.faqR6: A DropLink page explaining the link is no longer valid and inviting them to contact you. It reveals nothing about your shop.
docs.supportTexte: A question this page does not answer? Write to us from the report page: every message reaches the product team.
docs.ctaTitre: Ready to create your first link?
docs.ctaTexte: Free account, no credit card, ready in under a minute.
docs.metaDescription: The complete DropLink guide: create an order, add your photos, paste the tracking number and share a customer link.
docs.param1: Account: name, email and password — the email and password only change with your current password.
docs.param2: Preferences: interface language. The language of customer pages is set in My brand.
docs.param3: Security: two-factor authentication, active sessions, account deletion.
docs.param4: Data: export your data, delete everything — every destructive action asks for confirmation.
docs.param5: Subscription: current plan. During the validation phase, DropLink is free.
docs.kpiCreesE: Number of orders created over the period.
docs.kpiLivreesE: Orders the carrier has confirmed as delivered.
docs.kpiLiensE: Number of times your tracking pages were opened.
docs.kpiDelaiE: Average time between the carrier taking the parcel and delivering it.
docs.analysesSuite: On top of that: order trends over 7, 30 or 90 days, status breakdown, carrier usage and recent activity.
docs.clientVoit1: Your logo, the shop name and your social links.
docs.clientVoit2: The order reference and the estimated delivery date.
docs.clientVoit3: A tracking rail: Not scanned yet, Shipped, In transit, Delivered.
docs.clientVoit4: Your photos and videos of the order.
docs.clientVoit5: The carrier and the tracking number.
docs.clientVoit6: The detailed history of tracking events.
docs.transporteursTexte: The carrier is recognised from the tracking number. The <analyses>Analytics</analyses> screen shows how your shipments split between carriers.

lancement.texte: Create an order, drop in your photos and share a single link: your customer follows everything on their own, with no account.

parametres.sousTitre: Manage your account, your preferences and your DropLink setup.

compte.aide: Manage your personal information and your account.
compte.nouveauAide: 12 characters minimum. A phrase beats a complicated word.
compte.adresseEnvoyee: If this address can receive email, a confirmation link has just been sent to it. Your address only changes once that link is followed.
compte.adresseSuivie: Link followed. If a second confirmation is requested on your old address, follow it too: the address shown here is the one your account really has.
compte.motDePasseChange: Password changed. Your other devices have been signed out.
compte.sansMotDePasse: Signing in with Google? Set a password first with Forgot password.

preferences.languePubliqueAide: The language of the pages your customers see is set in My brand.

securite.aide: Protect your account and your data.
securite.ferme: Your other devices have been signed out.
securite.lectureImpossible: Your sessions can't be read right now. Please try again.
securite.fermerAide: Sign out all your other devices. This one stays signed in.

deuxEtapes.aide: Secure your account with a verification code.
deuxEtapes.motDePasseAide: Confirm your password to begin. You will need an authenticator app on your phone.
deuxEtapes.scanner: Scan this code with your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
deuxEtapes.qrAlt: QR code to scan with your authenticator app
deuxEtapes.cleAide: Keep it somewhere safe: it is the only way back in if you lose your device.
deuxEtapes.activeeOk: Two-factor authentication enabled. Your other devices will ask for the code next time they are used.
deuxEtapes.desactiverAide: Your account will no longer ask for a code when you log in. Confirm with your password.

abonnement.aide: Your plan during the validation phase.
abonnement.gratuitAide: During the validation phase, DropLink is free and unlimited.

erreurs.session: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
erreurs.trop: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
erreurs.mdpContientEmail: The password must not contain your email address.
erreurs.mdpIdentique: The new password must differ from the current one.
erreurs.adresseIdentique: This is already your account's address.
erreurs.indisponible: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
erreurs.code: Incorrect or expired code. Enter the code shown now.
erreurs.dejaActive: Two-factor authentication is already enabled on this account.
erreurs.confirmation: The address you typed does not match the account's.

donnees.aide: Manage your data and export your information.
donnees.exporterAide: Orders, parcels, media and views, in JSON. Without your internal notes.
donnees.avertissement: The file contains the public links of your orders: anyone who gets them sees your customers' pages. Store it accordingly.

compte.aide: Permanently delete your account and all your data.
compte.question: Delete the account?
compte.avertissement: This action is final. Your account, your orders, your shipments and your customer links will be deleted and cannot be restored.
compte.conservation: Only your email address and your sign-up and deletion dates are kept for one year, as the law requires of a host, then erased.

donnees.question: Delete all data?
donnees.avertissement: All your orders, photos, videos and customer links will be permanently deleted. Your account stays active but empty.
donnees.ok: All your data has been deleted.

suppression.recopier: Type your email address to confirm: {adresse}

verification.sousTitre: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
verification.perdu: Lost your device? Add the backup key you noted when enabling it to a new authenticator app.

erreurs.code: Incorrect or expired code. Enter the code shown now.
erreurs.invalide: Enter the 6 digits shown by your app.
erreurs.trop: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
erreurs.indisponible: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
